newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European fuel oil bunkers up, some short-covering.
newsitem.headline: European fuel oil bunkers up, some short-covering.

text.p: Fuel oil bunker prices in the whole of Europe gained $1/$2 a tonne on Friday with shipowners in many ports engaged in pre-weekend short-covering, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst fuel oil was about $1 a tonne in response to barge market strength. Quotes were at around $90/$91 fob.
Suppliers said demand in Rotterdam was not especially high.
"There is some demand in Antwerp, but in Rotterdam the strength is more due to (barge market) short-covering," one supplier said.
Hamburg fuel oil bunkers were similarly $1 a tonne firmer at around $95 delivered. Suppliers said the market had followed Rotterdam higher. Trading was fairly busy.
In the Mediterranean, however, fuel oil was up on average $2 a tonne. In Spain and Italy, suppliers reported good pre-weekend demand.
